caution_findings.finding: DBAASP rows for Mg2+ FICi and EDTA units conflict with the primary tables, and several target-activity rows omit salt/pH/temperature condition context. These rows remain source_conflict with locators instead of being silently source_verified.

Some killing and MIC50 values are recoverable only from figure bars or prose thresholds, not from machine-readable data tables; figure-derived rows explicitly carry visual-estimate or qualitative precision notes.
Ten local supplementary .bin assets were inspected and are publisher/support HTML landing pages, not structured supplementary assay tables; no supplementary value was fabricated from them.
No hemolysis, mammalian cytotoxicity, or toxicity endpoint for MUC7 12-mer was found in local primary materials; final activity evidence is antimicrobial/activity only.
